snippet.title: House of Legacy Releases May 15, 2025 | Build Your Dynasty. Shape a Legacy.
snippet.description:
After years of passionate development, the game is ready to meet the world. From our first concept to the final product, we’ve stayed true to our vision: to create a deep and immersive dynasty simulator. Although the game will enter Early Access, it already offers a wealth of content, and we’ll continue to expand and refine it based on your feedback.

In House of Legacy, you’ll take charge of a powerful family across generations of political intrigue, warfare, and legacy-building. Every decision you make can shape the course of your family’s future.

Key Features:
- Build Freely. With over 200 modular building pieces, you can design your own mansion, farm, or city just the way you like.

- Raise a Dynasty. Guide your descendants through generations, managing assets like estates, shops, land, and property.

- Family Politics. Each playthrough randomly generates about 30 unique noble families. Cooperate or compete with them as dynamic NPCs form their own relationships, grudges, and rivalries.

- Climb the Ranks. Pass the imperial exams, govern territories, rise through the bureaucracy or fall from grace. Join the military, earn titles, and bless future generations.

- Lead in Battle. Command your armies, conquer territories, and navigate the complex politics between the court and rebels to shift the balance of power.

- Seize Power. Support the ruling dynasty or help crown a new emperor — perhaps even from your own bloodline — and steer the fate of the empire.

- Dynamic World. Experience unpredictable events, shifting loyalties, political drama, and family interactions that affect the course of your entire campaign.

Thank you again for all your patience, feedback, and support. Yep, May 15 — let’s do it. Let your legacy begin. Step into the world of House of Legacy and write your own chapter in history.
